reason: Both correctly identify the same four core defects (LEFT JOIN turned INNER via WHERE, UTC vs. local-day mismatch, NULL total_spent instead of 0, integer division truncation) with similarly accurate explanations, but Response A also flags the non-aggregated GROUP BY columns (c.name, c.signup_date) as a real portability/strict-SQL-mode defect, appropriately caveating its severity — an additional true finding B misses entirely. B's extra remark about NULL sort order in defect #3 is a nice elaboration but not an independent defect, so it doesn't offset A's greater completeness.
